textChanges.new:
Draw targets the survey destination; offer-span replaces it with the actual trace end when that is the actionable target. Never change a marker behind an unchanged objective. Continuous walking retains one quiet work order: no sample/turn prompt, chime or congratulatory microstep. Witness vacancy publishes the appropriate survey or final reference-return objective; missing footing publishes revision because occupancy cannot repair ground. Alternative nearby actions use the same resolver without competing required markers.

Preparation is an explicitly signed conditional state within the existing objective ID. `ch13:survey:test` enters at `anc.cg.route-offered`, keeps its one actual-worker target and the neutral label `W-7744 · offered route`, and before his actual arrival at the offered test start uses exactly: `W-7744 is preparing to test the offered route.` / `Keep his approach clear. Follow his progress, or return to the last tested point to revise.` At actual approach completion, replace this with the exact testing work order already in the table. `ch13:common:reciprocal` enters at `anc.cg.route-tested` with its one eventual C target and exact preparation copy: `W-7744 is taking up the reference position.` / `Give him room to reach it. When the guide appears, follow it from the survey end.` Only actual H arrival at `anc.cg.reciprocal-reference` enables the guide, the exact holding/guide-line work order and comparison-credit eligibility. These readiness transitions silently replace standing copy within the same ID: no second entry acknowledgement, target change, F, score event, new anchor or positioning-leg proof. A body-blocked approach safely holds and resumes when clear; preparation wording must remain true while stationary. Pause/restore revalidates actual readiness and republishes silently. Raw lifecycle evidence must show the exact preparing copy at entry and exact ready copy after real arrival, with one marker and one entry cue.
